utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m sorry, Nell — I’m still a bit scattered, but I can sort the tools and check the sign-up list. Just poke me if I start wandering off looking for my wrench again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries, Oren — I’ll keep an eye out and nudge you if needed. I’m still checking for those screws and tape, so I’ll bring them by if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep on the tools and the sign-up list, and if I spot my wrench I’ll finally remember where I put it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—just let me know what we’re short on, and I’ll help round it up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo — I think I missed the latest list. What are you still short on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still short on a few boxes of screws and some sturdy tape. If you spot either, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo — a few extra hands would help a lot. Could you help sort the tools and set up the table?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I can sort the tools and set up the table.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still in for the repair drive, and I can help keep track of the sign-up list too. Just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a huge help, Mara — let’s start with the sign-up list and then we can sort the tasks by what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll sort the sign-up list and flag the urgent jobs first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still on for the repair drive? And can you confirm the timing and drop-off spot before we set anything up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — we’re still on for the repair drive. I’ll send you the timing and drop-off spot so you can set things up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I’ll wait for the timing and exact drop-off spot before I set anything up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I still haven’t heard anything new yet, but I’m keeping an ear out for the repair drive. As soon as I do, I’ll pass it along right away!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep to the plan and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll let you know the moment I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Opal — I’ll mention the repair drive while I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — if you hear where the repair drive is, let me know so I can keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know where it’s being held.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I can send the details, or I can just tell you the drop-off time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the drop-off time and what to bring is perfect — I’m moving fast today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community shed. Just bring small appliances or tools, and if you can, tape up any loose parts so they don’t spill out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around pickup and drop-off, so just let me know the repair drive time when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I’ll let you know as soon as the repair drive time is set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — thanks, Rey. I’ll keep my schedule flexible around pickup and drop-off once you have the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Vik — I really appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll keep everything organized, so if you hear of any tools or needs, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or needs and pass them along to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m finalizing the schedule now, but I’m aiming for Friday morning. I’ll send the exact time and supply list over as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Friday morning works for me. Just send the exact time and supply list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — I’m still waiting on the schedule and drop-off spot before I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, Pia — once we have the schedule and drop-off spot, I can pitch in too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Dane — that helps. I’ll wait for the schedule and drop-off spot, then we can line it up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’m still keeping an ear out for repair drive updates. If you hear anything, let me know and I can help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I will — just send me the timing and the exact drop-off spot when you have it, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll pass along the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I hear them. Thanks, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Kira — I’ve still got a few tools set aside, so let me know what you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on, right? Can you confirm the timing and exact drop-off spot before we set anything up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on — I’m planning for Saturday morning, and we can use the community shed by the playground for drop-offs. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still nothing new on the repair drive, but I’m listening for updates. If I hear anything, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know right away if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details now so I don’t mix anything up. What time and meeting spot are we using?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still using the same plan — I’ll spread the word and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare. Once you’ve got the time and meeting spot, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still checking the time and meeting spot, and I’ll share them as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Anytime this afternoon works — I’ll be out running errands, so I can point people your way too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll come by this afternoon. Just let me know if there’s a spot you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the update again; do you need me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — just a screwdriver and maybe a spare bulb would help. The porch light and the loose fence gate are still the main things.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring a screwdriver and see if I have a spare bulb. If the list changes again, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around school pickup and drop-off—just let me know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send you the time as soon as it’s set, and I’ll loop you in on the supply list too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — that works for me. Just keep me posted once the time is set and I’ll plan around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still in for the repair drive, and I can help keep the list organized too. Just let me know what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Mara. Could you start by keeping the list updated while I sort the donated tools and load the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep the list updated while you sort the tools and load the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it — porch light and fence gate, nice and simple. I’ll take them one at a time and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli — thanks for taking those on. Just let me know if you run into anything tricky and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Sam. I’ll start with the porch light, then handle the fence gate and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can check around for both and bring them by if I find them. If you think of anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell — that helps. If you find the tools or boxes, just bring them by and I’ll sort and load them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and drop them off if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep a running list and make sure everything stays organized. Send me any items and where they’re coming from when you spot them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do, Rosa — I’ll send along any items I spot with their locations so your list stays up to date.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be perfect—tape and a small screwdriver sound great. I’m still sorting the list, so I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the tape and screwdriver, and I’ll handle the flyer and signup board too. Just send me anything else when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — that’s a huge help. I’ll send you anything else once I finish sorting the list.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
